about_the_game:
Bean Quest is a game about collecting items and beating progressively harder missions and enemy's. Collect a variety of weapons, and different armor sets. This game revolves around campaigns, that have multiple missions in them. These campaigns start from the medieval ages, and will eventually get up to current times and beyond!

Main features in Bean Quest

  • Collect a variety of weapons with different types.

  • Collect different armor sets with varying stats.

  • Rarity system that allows better stats on the same item

  • Player stats including: Health, Experience Points (XP), Gold, and More coming soon!

  • Building system to build your own house!

  • Shops system to buy, transfer, or unlock more items!

Main lobby includes Districts that the player can enter to do a variety of things. At this point, the main districts includes:

  • Training District

  • Missions District

  • Housing District

  • Shops District

  • Tutorial District

This game is still very early in development and more is coming soon!
